theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_tda_im_median_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (F : Set α) (a c : ℝ) (u : α → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < a → Measurable u → ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | u x ≤ c}) → ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | c ≤ u x}) → ENNReal.ofReal (|c| * a) ≤ 2 * ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x| ∂μ ∧ (c ≠ 0 → μ (F ∩ {x | u x ≠ 0}) ≠ 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
